steps.npc: Sorry, I don't have time for idle chit-chat, I need to send a fairy to get little Freddies tooth!
Sorry, I don't have time to talk, I need to send a Tooth Fairy to visit Sarah-Jane!
Sorry, I don't have time for idle chit-chat, I need to find a Winter Fairy to send to Trollheim!
Sorry, I don't have time to stop, I need to send a Weather Fairy off to Etceteria!
Sorry, I don't have time for idle chit-chat, I need to send an Autumn Fairy off to Burthorpe!

using-nuff-s-certificate-on-her.text: You show the certificate to the Fairy Coordinator.

using-nuff-s-certificate-on-her.player: Do you know what these strange marks mean?

using-nuff-s-certificate-on-her.speaker: Gatekeeper
using-nuff-s-certificate-on-her.text: They look familiar, but I can't think where I've seen marks like that. Try asking around, maybe somebody else will recognise them.
